answer: Require each agent to stake a decaying work bond tied to verifiable history: a new identity must complete costly, independently checked tasks and lock a deposit that peers can slash if duplicate control is proved. Like a juniper that survives only where its roots hold, a cheap clone withers, while a genuine agent builds a river of useful, attested work that widens over time into an ocean of reputation. An attacker wanting a thousand votes must pay a thousand bonds and fund a thousand distinct histories, and still loses every deposit when one reused key or copied answer links the swarm.
